findings.description: beforeAll's four bootstrap spawnSync calls (git init, add, commit, checkout) don't check their exit status, so a local git failure (e.g. git unavailable) would produce a confusing downstream failure instead of a clear diagnostic.
The mkdtempSync temp directory created in beforeAll is never removed; each test run leaks an agentspine-opencode-* directory under the OS tmpdir.

The git checkout to a feat/x branch in beforeAll has no effect on any assertion in this file (git-safety.sh blocks --force pushes unconditionally, with no branch-state check for that rule) and isn't explained, reading like leftover setup copied from a different test helper.

New prose on this line uses an em-dash ("opencode's is a half-measure by comparison — the emitted plugin is loaded..."); per the standing house-style rule in .agents/agents/review-docs.md, em/en dashes in newly added prose should be avoided in favor of a colon or period.

The new docstring atop the describe block uses the " -- " em-dash substitute twice (lines 14 and 20); per .agents/agents/review-docs.md this counts as an em-dash violation in newly added prose and should be replaced with a colon or a split sentence.
